a.lede: Eccentric and overhyped, Tesla’s Cybertruck became a stand-in for Elon Musk during his ascent in the Republican party. It will join the ranks of other vehicles symbolic of their eras – for better or for worse Three days after a historic blue tsunami changed America’s political landscape, Elon Musk announced Tesla would end production of its hulking Cybertruck next year.
a.title: Farewell, Cybertruck: why the winding down of the ‘Maga hat on wheels’ is a sign of the times

b.lede: Tesla’s unpredictable CEO is ready to move on from the company’s most controversial vehicle, but owners aren’t about to let him off the hook for what they see as a poor decision.
b.title: ‘Call Him Out’: Cybertruck Loyalists Are in Mourning—and They Want Answers From Elon Musk
